name: MonarchAiMessageActions
title: AiMessageActions
wrapsNative: MonarchIconButton, androidx.compose.material3.IconToggleButton and androidx.compose.material3.TooltipBox with PlainTooltip (with icons), or MonarchButton and MonarchChip (without), MonarchCopyButton and MonarchMenu, in an androidx.compose.foundation.layout.FlowRow
summary: The action row under a chat message: copy, regenerate, edit, rate, share, read aloud and a menu of further actions.
whenToUse: Under each assistant answer (copy, regenerate, rate, share, read aloud) and under a person's own message (copy, edit) in a conversation.
whenNotToUse: For rating with reasons and a comment use MonarchAiFeedback; for actions on a whole conversation use a TopAppBar menu; for one copy button use MonarchCopyButton.
api: @Composable fun MonarchAiMessageActions(messageText: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, onCopy: ((String) -> Unit)? = null, onRegenerate: (() -> Unit)? = null, onEdit: (() -> Unit)? = null, feedback: MonarchAiMessageFeedback? = null, onFeedback: ((MonarchAiMessageFeedback?) -> Unit)? = null, onShare: (() -> Unit)? = null, speaking: Boolean = false, onReadAloud: ((speaking: Boolean) -> Unit)? = null, enabled: Boolean = true, icon: (@Composable (action: MonarchAiMessageAction, active: Boolean) -> Unit)? = null, moreIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchAiMessageActionsLabels = MonarchAiMessageActionsLabels(), more: (@Composable ColumnScope.(close: () -> Unit) -> Unit)? = null)
enum class MonarchAiMessageAction { Copy, Regenerate, Edit, Good, Bad, Share, ReadAloud, More }

class MonarchAiMessageActionsLabels(toolbar: String? = null, copy: String? = null, copied: String? = null, regenerate: String? = null, edit: String? = null, good: String? = null, bad: String? = null, share: String? = null, readAloud: String? = null, stopReading: String? = null, more: String? = null)

options.name: messageText
options.description: The message's plain text: what Copy copies and what the app reads aloud.

options.name: onCopy
options.description: Shows Copy (a MonarchCopyButton); called with the text after it is on the clipboard.

options.name: onEdit
options.description: Shows Edit, for the person's own messages.

options.name: feedback
options.description: The current rating, shown as a pressed thumb.

options.name: onFeedback
options.description: Shows thumbs up and down; called with the new rating, or null when the pressed thumb is pressed again.

options.name: onShare
options.description: Shows Share; start Intent.ACTION_SEND with Intent.createChooser here.

options.name: speaking
options.description: Whether the app is reading the message aloud; the button then reads Stop reading.

options.name: onReadAloud
options.description: Shows Read aloud; called with true to start and false to stop. The app owns TextToSpeech.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the actions can be used, for example false while the answer streams.

options.name: icon
options.description: The glyph of each action, given whether it is active (copied, pressed or speaking). Null shows the actions as text.

options.name: moreIcon
options.description: The glyph of the More actions button; null shows it as text.

options.name: more
options.description: The items of the menu of further actions, for example DropdownMenuItems; null hides the More actions button.

states.name: rated
states.description: The chosen thumb is on (a checked toggle, or a selected chip) and its glyph uses the AI strong color.

states.name: copied
states.description: Copy shows Copied and the copied glyph where the system shows no clipboard confirmation (below Android 13); the copy is announced.

states.name: speaking
states.description: Read aloud becomes Stop reading and its glyph is given as active.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Every action is disabled and uses the disabled text color.

states.name: menu open
states.description: A MonarchMenu with the app's items.

appearance: Icon buttons without a container in the muted text color; a pressed thumb uses the AI strong color, disabled actions the disabled text color. Without icons, ghost Monarch buttons and Material 3 filter chips in the theme. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web shows the row on hover with pointer devices and as one tab stop with arrow keys; on Android the row is always visible and each action is its own TalkBack element. The web speaks with speechSynthesis itself; Android leaves TextToSpeech to the app (it needs an engine, initialisation and a lifecycle), which passes speaking and starts or stops speech in onReadAloud. Share is a callback so the app chooses what to send through Intent.ACTION_SEND. Web tooltips on hover become Material 3 plain tooltips on long press. Monarch bundles no icons, so icons are a slot and every action can also be shown as text. The thumbs use the same Material 3 controls as MonarchAiFeedback (IconToggleButton or MonarchChip); for reasons and a comment after a rating, show MonarchAiFeedback instead of onFeedback. The web's more slot is a menu here: moreIcon and more open a MonarchMenu. iOS has no entry yet.
accessibility: The row is a traversal group named "Message actions".
Each icon button is named for TalkBack ("Regenerate", "Share") and has a 48dp target; the glyph is hidden.
The thumbs are toggles that report on and off; as chips they report selected.
Long-pressing an icon button shows its name in a plain tooltip, so the meaning never rests on the glyph.
Copy announces the copy through MonarchCopyButton's polite live region.
Read aloud changes its name to "Stop reading" while speaking.
Text actions wrap onto more rows at font scale 2.0.
edgeCases: With no callbacks the row is empty.
Pressing the pressed thumb again clears the rating (onFeedback(null)).
Copy copies messageText as given; strip markdown before passing it if the answer is formatted.
Keep enabled false while the answer streams so Copy and Read aloud do not act on partial text.

examples.title: All actions
examples.template:
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space2)) {
    MonarchAiMessageActions(
        messageText = {{messageText}},
        onCopy = { last = "copy" },
        onRegenerate = { last = "regenerate" },
        feedback = feedback,
        onFeedback = { feedback = it },
        onShare = { last = "share" },
        speaking = speaking,
        onReadAloud = { speaking = it },
    )
    MonarchText(text = "Last action: " + (last ?: "Nothing yet"), style = MonarchTextStyle.Caption)
}
examples.code:
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space2)) {
    MonarchAiMessageActions(
        messageText = "The draft has three sections and a list of next steps.",
        onCopy = { last = "copy" },
        onRegenerate = { last = "regenerate" },
        feedback = feedback,
        onFeedback = { feedback = it },
        onShare = { last = "share" },
        speaking = speaking,
        onReadAloud = { speaking = it },
    )
    MonarchText(text = "Last action: " + (last ?: "Nothing yet"), style = MonarchTextStyle.Caption)
}

examples.title: A person's own message, with a menu
examples.code:
MonarchAiMessageActions(
    messageText = "Draft the reply to Ada",
    onCopy = {},
    onEdit = {},
    more = { close ->
        MonarchMenuItem(text = "Delete message", onClick = close, destructive = true)
    },
)
